description: The Codebelt.Extensions.AspNetCore.Mvc.Formatters.Newtonsoft.Json namespace contains both types and extension methods that complements both the Codebelt.Extensions.Newtonsoft.Json/Codebelt.Extensions.AspNetCore.Newtonsoft.Json namespace while being an addition to the Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc namespace. Provides JSON formatters for ASP.NET Core MVC that is powered by Newtonsoft.Json.
